name: Cat-Cow
steps: Start on hands and knees in a tabletop position with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and enter the 'Cow' pose: lower your belly toward the mat, gently arch your back, and lift your chest and chin toward the ceiling.
Exhale and transition into the 'Cat' pose: draw your belly button toward your spine, round your back up toward the ceiling, and tuck your chin to your chest.
Move slowly and rhythmically between Cat and Cow, matching movement to your breath.
Perform 8 to 10 fluid transitions through the full, comfortable range of your spine.
coaching_cues: Flow through the spine segment by segment rather than moving rigidly.
Never force into extreme arching or rounding if you experience any pinching.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders relaxed away from your ears.
